Russia launches strikes on Ukraine; both sides report drone activity

Russia has conducted missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, resulting in civilian casualties and injuries. Simultaneously, Russia claims to have intercepted a large number of Ukrainian drones. The conflict, ongoing for nearly four and a half years, continues to impact civilian populations and infrastructure in both nations, with Ukraine's president appealing for enhanced air defense systems.
